steps.name: tax_at_3
steps.label: Tax at 3% (gross income this year above GEL 500 000)

citation.fr: Code des impôts de Géorgie, articles 88(1), 90(1)-(2)

legal_source.note: Art. 88(1): the status may be granted to an entrepreneur natural person. Art. 90(1): taxable income taxed at 1%; 90(2): 3% from the beginning of the month in which gross income from economic activities exceeded GEL 500 000 (GEL 700 000 for wine and agro tourism operators, not encoded) until the end of the calendar year. Art. 90(3): taxable income is Georgian-source income except salary and income types excluded under 88(3). Not covered: the 700 000 limit, excluded income types, revocation (Art. 89), the GEL 6 000 salary exemption (94(4)). effective_from is the publication date of Law No 3922 (27.12.2023), the latest amendment to Art. 88-90 in the rad_law snapshot, not a verified entry-into-force date. Needs review by a qualified accountant before last_verified_date is set.
